==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will only use this skill while in combat so long as at least one party member in earshot needs healing. If party members move out of earshot range of the spirit and are still in need of healing, the hero will recast it.

== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Rejuvenation]].
* The spirit is created with a higher level than other spirits at the same attribute rank. At 21 Restoration Magic, it is level 28, which is the highest leveled summoned spirit in the game. 
* Only heals party members below full health, so while your party hasn't started combat, try not to equip [[vampiric]] weapon modifiers.
* At level 14 (0 [[Spawning Power]]), Rejuvenation does the equivalent of 5 [[pip]]s of [[health regeneration]] for a total of 38 seconds distributed amongst the party members (1 party member under its effect will receive 38 seconds while 4 party members will receive 9.5 seconds, etc.).

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
